decisions.rationale: APC here is the gene symbol in 'Regionally clustered APC mutations' (a gene and its mutations), not a disease name, so it is not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 1 (organism/non-disease names) and general scope of disease mentions in What to Annotate 1

decisions.rationale: 'adenomatous polyposis coli' names one specific disease with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: APC in 'Germline mutation in APC at 5q21-22' refers to the gene locus/gene, not the disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (disease mentions only) and What NOT to Annotate 1

decisions.rationale: 'syndrome' is a very general term and is excluded when used without a specific disease name.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms such as 'syndrome')

decisions.rationale: 'adenomatous polyposis coli' is a single specific disease; the preceding general word 'syndrome' is excluded, leaving the disease name as the minimal span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: 'APC' in parentheses is the abbreviation defined by the long form 'adenomatous polyposis coli' and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention of the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions and abbreviation definitions)

decisions.rationale: 'colorectal tumourigenesis' refers to a biological process (tumour formation), not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 5 (biological processes such as tumorigenesis)

decisions.rationale: 'disease' used alone in 'the disease' is a very general term and is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms such as 'disease')

decisions.rationale: 'cancer' is retained per the guidelines and, as a generic term, refers to a family of multiple specific diseases, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 (cancer and tumor are retained) and What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class)

decisions.rationale: 'APC' in 'unselected APC patients' is the disease name used as a modifier of the noun 'patients', so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: 'APC' in 'the APC mutations detected' refers to the gene and its mutations rather than to the disease, so it is not annotated as a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (disease mentions only) and What NOT to Annotate 1
